name: saygoweb/frontaccounting-module-sgw_import
description: Bank data import module for FrontAccounting

scripts.lint: find . \( -name vendor -o -name node_modules \) -prune -o -type f -name '*.php' -print0 | xargs -0 -n1 php -l

scripts-descriptions.test: Run the PHPUnit suites. integration and http need FrontAccounting and the GraphQL module beside this one: tools/ci.sh in FrontAccounting's CI image does that.
scripts-descriptions.test:coverage: test, with a Clover report in build/coverage.xml (tools/coverage.sh loads xdebug for it).
scripts-descriptions.lint: php -l over every PHP file in the module.
scripts-descriptions.cs:check: Check includes/ and tests/ against PSR-12 (phpcs.xml).
scripts-descriptions.cs:fix: Fix what phpcbf can fix automatically.
scripts-descriptions.ci: quality, then test - the gates tools/ci.sh runs.
